_about: Curated facets for games Steam cannot describe. Every appid and crew_max below was verified against Steam store pages, official wikis or developer posts. crew_max is the OFFICIAL supported co-op count. Where a game goes higher with community mods or a server config, crew_max stays official and crew_mod carries the bigger number, because a filter that quietly assumes everyone has installed a mod is a filter that lies. null crew_max means genuinely unconfirmed, and the app shows 'cap unknown' rather than inventing one.

_fields.c: crew_max: official supported co-op players, null if unconfirmed
_fields.m: crew_mod: higher player count reachable with mods or server config
_fields.n: note shown when someone taps the cap
